view_definition:
WITH current_file AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (ingest_runs.source_slug, ingest_runs.dataset_name) ingest_runs.source_slug,
            ingest_runs.dataset_name,
            ingest_runs.source_file_id,
            ingest_runs.coverage
           FROM ingest_runs
          WHERE ingest_runs.relation_name = 'directory'::text AND ingest_runs.status = 'complete'::text AND ingest_runs.source_file_id IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY ingest_runs.source_slug, ingest_runs.dataset_name, ingest_runs.finished_at DESC, ingest_runs.started_at DESC
        ), completed_source AS (
         SELECT current_file.source_slug
           FROM current_file
          GROUP BY current_file.source_slug
         HAVING bool_or(current_file.dataset_name = 'directory-current'::text) OR count(*) FILTER (WHERE current_file.dataset_name ~ '^directory-state-[0-9]{2}(-part-[0-9]+)?$'::text) >= COALESCE(max(
                CASE
                    WHEN (current_file.coverage ->> 'publisher_file_count'::text) ~ '^[0-9]+$'::text THEN (current_file.coverage ->> 'publisher_file_count'::text)::integer
                    ELSE NULL::integer
                END), 2147483647)
        ), active_taxonomy AS (
         SELECT taxonomy_publications.id,
            taxonomy_publications.classifier_version,
            taxonomy_publications.directory_basis_sha256,
            taxonomy_publications.published_at
           FROM taxonomy_publications
          WHERE taxonomy_publications.status = 'published'::text
          ORDER BY taxonomy_publications.published_at DESC, taxonomy_publications.id DESC
         LIMIT 1
        )
 SELECT d.id,
    d.source_slug,
    COALESCE(c.dataset_name, 'legacy-cutover'::text) AS dataset_name,
    d.source_record_id,
    d.observed_kind,
    d.legal_name,
    d.trade_name,
    d.activity_text,
    d.products_services,
    d.industry_codes,
    d.categories,
    d.country_code,
    d.state_code,
    d.state_name,
    d.municipality,
    d.postal_code,
    d.website,
    d.domain,
    exhibited_business_contacts(d.source_slug, d.source_record_id, d.business_contacts, d.raw_record) AS business_contacts,
    d.source_url,
    d.source_span,
    d.artifact_sha256,
    d.storage_uri,
    d.provenance,
    d.source_retrieved_at,
    d.updated_at,
    exhibited_source_fields(d.source_slug, d.raw_record) AS source_fields,
    te.supplier_roles,
        CASE
            WHEN te.directory_entry_id IS NOT NULL THEN at.classifier_version
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS role_classifier_version,
    te.classified_at AS role_classified_at,
    row_evidence(d.source_slug, COALESCE(c.dataset_name, 'legacy-cutover'::text), d.source_record_id, d.source_url, d.source_span, NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint, d.artifact_sha256, d.source_retrieved_at) AS evidence
   FROM directory_entries d
     LEFT JOIN current_file c ON c.source_slug = d.source_slug AND c.source_file_id = d.source_file_id
     LEFT JOIN active_taxonomy at ON true
     LEFT JOIN taxonomy_entries te ON te.publication_id = at.id AND te.directory_entry_id = d.id AND te.directory_row_hash = d.row_hash
  WHERE c.source_file_id IS NOT NULL OR d.source_file_id IS NULL AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM completed_source done
          WHERE done.source_slug = d.source_slug)) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM current_file c2
          WHERE c2.source_slug = d.source_slug AND c2.dataset_name ~ '^directory-state-[0-9]{2}(-part-[0-9]+)?$'::text AND ((c2.coverage ->> 'state_code'::text) = d.state_code OR d.source_slug = 'denue'::text AND (c2.coverage ->> 'entity'::text) ~ '^[0-9]{1,2}$'::text AND "left"(d.source_record_id, 2) = lpad(c2.coverage ->> 'entity'::text, 2, '0'::text))));
